title: service-settings: a select / radio / multiselect key admits any value when its option source answers an empty list (the map-key gap #31422 closed, on the select family)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pXkgNXVpCn2GZDjyy

Filing gate: ② a non-blocking nit (Finding 1) from the at-tier contract review of PR #31539 (#31422), record 6722607950. The card thread noted it in its os-dev-report (6722247790) and did not file it. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reach: every select, radio or multiselect settings key whose registered option source answers an empty list. The value is admitted instead of being refused. This applies at both doors, the save (`validatePatch`, ~l.3420 on `main`) and the `OS_*` env override (`effectiveEnvOverride`, ~l.1532), because each keeps its own `allowed.length > 0` gate.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p3 (self-graded; Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 「定级你可以自己决定」). Nothing ships wrong today unless a source legitimately answers empty. The review names `localization.locale` as the key with real reach, which is the list the boot hold/seal exists for.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `allowed.length select option source empty`, `select key fails closed` found only #31422 / PR #31539, which fixed the map family.

## 维护者速读

#31422 让 map 设置的键在选项来源答了空列表时也会拒绝（以前放行任何键）。select / radio / multiselect 这一族还有同样的缺口：来源答空列表时任何值都放行。这是第二个收紧，影响面不同（如 `localization.locale`），所以单独立卡。

## Task

- Apply #31422's rule to the select family: once a reachable option source has answered (with `sourced` as PR #31539's `optionTableOf` reports it), the value is judged against that answer, an empty answer included. The `allowed.length > 0` gate stays only for the declared-options fallback. Do this at both doors.
- Read the boot hold/seal for `localization.locale` first. An empty answer during boot must not refuse a locale that a later answer would admit. Say in the report how the hold covers it.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The changeset says so, with the same `adr-0087` line #31539 used if the gate asks for one.
- Riding along, from the same review (an observation, not graded): `reportRejectedEnvOverride` dedupes on `String(offending)`, which is `[object Object]` for every map. A second, different bad map under the same `OS_LIFECYCLE_*` var is therefore silenced after the first line. This predates #31386. Dedupe on a stable serialisation instead.

## Acceptance

- Pins, red then green: a registered source answering `[]` refuses a select value at the save door and at the env door. The declared-options fallback is unchanged. Two different bad maps under one env var each log once.

Refs #31422, PR #31539, #30208
